repos_data.description: A Rust library for browser automation via Chrome DevTools Protocol with built-in AI integration through Model Context Protocol (MCP)

Undetected browser automation MCP server - a stealth, anti-bot-resistant alternative to chrome-devtools-mcp for Claude, Cursor and AI agents. Powered by nodriver (bypasses Cloudflare/WebDriver detection). 65 tools, plus several isolated browsers at once so parallel agents never share a session.
⚡ CloakBrowser MCP server for AI agents: Playwright-powered browsing, clean tool forwarding, Docker support, and multi-session HTTP transport.

One endpoint in front of unlimited MCP servers and REST APIs. The agent sees a fixed ~15-tool surface however many you connect, so tool-list token cost stays flat (about 89% less on a 100-tool stack) and the savings climb as you add more. Single Rust binary.
Fast, local-first web content extraction for LLMs. Scrape, crawl, extract structured data — all from Rust. CLI, REST API, and MCP server.
MCP server for searching AI agents, MCP servers, CLI tools and agent skills via A2ASearch
Token-efficient browser automation MCP for AI agents, with semantic page snapshots and stable element IDs.
The unified web layer for AI agents. Search (8 engines), stealth browse, auth, and act on 24 platforms. One npm install, self-hosted.
MCP server for browser automation — 220 tools for Chrome, Edge & Firefox via CDP + BiDi. 13 capability tiers, stealth mode, Lighthouse audits. No Node.js, no Chromium download. 100% Python.
Browser automation MCP server with event-driven deterministic snapshots (Playwright + a11y tree) / 事件驱动确定性快照的浏览器操控 MCP 服务器
Open-source MCP server for AI agents: web search, content extraction, and library docs -- 5-strategy scraping, runs without API keys.
MCP tool server for AI coding agents -- encoding-aware file tools, binary analysis, DAP debugger, SSH/SFTP, process memory, and more

repo_meta_data.description: acrawl — LLM-powered web crawler. Describe what you want in plain English, get structured data back. Single Rust binary, 25 providers, MCP server built-in.
